subject: Using greek letters in tip label and NHX annotations

messages.author: 4277004cf972e0df
messages.subject: Using greek letters in tip label and NHX annotations
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to use greek letters alpha, beta as part of the tip labels. I tried using unicode letters but 
For example:
treetext = "(((ADH2 \u03b1:0.1[&&NHX:S=human \u03b1 ], ADH1:0.11[&&NHX:S=human]):0.05 [&&NHX:S=primates:D=Y:B=100],ADHY:0.1[&&NHX:S=nematode],ADHX:0.12 [&&NHX:S=insect]):0.1[&&NHX:S=metazoa:D=N],(ADH4:0.09[&&NHX:S=yeast],
ADH3:0.13[&&NHX:S=yeast], ADH2:0.12[&&NHX:S=yeast],ADH1:0.11[&&NHX:S=yeast]):0.1[&&NHX:S=Fungi][&&NHX:D=N];"
tree <- read.nhx(textConnection(treetext))
ggtree(tree) + geom_tiplab() + geom_label(aes(x=branch, label=S), fill='lightgreen') + 
  geom_label(aes(label=D), fill='steelblue') + geom_text(aes(label=B), hjust=-.5)
p <- p %>% collapse(node=10) + geom_point2(aes(subset=(node==10)), shape=23, size=3, fill='black')

This added the letter "a" not alpha. Also I could not collapse nodes if I use the unicode letter in treetext.

Please help me with this issue.
